title: Bayesian Sequential Search with Censored Observations
abstract: arXiv:2608.14326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies how information censoring enables a myopic cutoff rule in Bayesian sequential search. Under full information, Bayesian learning generally destroys the monotonicity of continuation values, preventing simple cutoff rules. We show that one-sided censoring restores monotonicity by limiting posterior fluctuations, thereby making a myopic cutoff rule optimal. By decomposing the intertemporal change in the marginal value of search into a fallback-value effect and a learning effect, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for monotonicity under lower censoring and characterize the optimal cutoff rule. In contrast, under full revelation, monotonicity requires highly restrictive conditions. We further show that expected monotonicity (i.e., the supermartingale property) is characterized by the same conditions under both lower censoring and full revelation, owing to Bayes plausibility and the affine structure of the problem.

translated_title: 带删失观测的贝叶斯序贯搜索
translated_abstract: 本文研究了信息删失如何使得贝叶斯序贯搜索中的短视截止规则成为可能。在完全信息下，贝叶斯学习通常会破坏延续值的单调性，从而阻止简单的截止规则。我们证明，单侧删失通过限制后验波动恢复了单调性，从而使短视截止规则成为最优。通过将搜索边际价值的跨期变化分解为回退值效应和学习效应，我们推导出下删失下单调性的充分必要条件，并刻画了最优截止规则。相比之下，在完全揭示下，单调性需要高度限制性的条件。我们进一步表明，期望单调性（即超鞅性质）在下删失和完全揭示下由相同的条件刻画，这归因于贝叶斯合理性以及问题的仿射结构。
tldr: 本文发现单侧删失通过限制后验波动恢复单调性，使短视截止规则在贝叶斯序贯搜索中成为最优，并给出了单调性的充要条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that one-sided censoring restores monotonicity by limiting posterior fluctuations, making a myopic cutoff rule optimal in Bayesian sequential search, and characterizes the necessary and sufficient conditions for monotonicity.
